# Matias Ezequiel Marani

> Senior Full Stack Developer & Engineering Manager based in Madrid, Spain. 7+ years building scalable web applications, 4+ years leading development teams. Advanced proficiency in the JavaScript ecosystem (Vanilla JS, Vue 2/3, Node.js) and Go, with a track record of delivering complex projects from conception to deployment.

Information Systems Engineer. Open source author of img2gcode (Node.js/Jimp npm package that converts JPG, JPEG, PNG and GIF images to G-code for CNC/laser, 42 stars) and codereview.nvim (Neovim plugin for reviewing Git diffs with inline notes, unified/split views, Markdown/table exports, Telescope and Git difftool integration, 10 stars). Currently available for opportunities.

## Experience

- EXTE (formerly SunMedia) — Frontend Developer & Team Leader, July 2021–Present. Led a team of 5 developers building SunStudio, a Figma-like web ad creation platform. Architected the project structure and tech stack, implemented DDD and Hexagonal Architecture, set up GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and trained 15+ team members on Vite and GitLab CI. Stack: Vue3, Pinia, Vite, Vitest, Python, GitLab CI/CD.
- SunMedia — Senior Frontend Developer, December 2020–July 2021. Built a data management application for advertising campaigns and the company's shared UI component library, used across 8+ internal projects. Improved app speed by 30%. Stack: Vue.js, Vuex, Webpack, Jest.
- Rapicopia — Full Stack Developer, November 2018–August 2021. Built the frontend for a customer management system and RapicopiaApp, a local Go server application for branch printing and note management. Reduced customer processing time by 25%. Stack: Vue.js, Nuxt.js, Webpack, Go.
- Tribal Consulting — Full Stack Developer, July 2018–October 2020. Delivered multiple client projects, including cross-platform mobile apps with Ionic. Stack: Vue.js, Ionic, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.js, Nuxt.js, Webpack.

## Key Projects

- Hornera (personal project): End-to-end rental management system for a temporary rental company, covering availability, cleaning coordination, maintenance scheduling, billing, and Booking.com & Airbnb integration. Automated 90% of manual processes and cut operational costs by 50%. Stack: Go backend, MariaDB, Vue3 frontend, Framework7 mobile app.
- [img2gcode](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/img2gcode): Converts JPG/PNG/GIF images into G-code for CNC machines and laser engravers, using a pathfinding algorithm to find the shortest trace between pixels. TypeScript, Node.js. 42 stars.
- [codereview.nvim](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/codereview.nvim): Neovim plugin for reviewing any Git diff with inline notes, unified or split diff views, file explorer, Markdown/table exports for LLM workflows, Telescope support, and Git difftool integration. Lua, Neovim. 10 stars.
